chunks: As for whatever is in it from Muṣʿab ibn Yazīd al-Anṣārī, the governor of Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام, I have narrated it from my father and from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan—may Allah be pleased with them both—from Saʿd ibn ʿAbd Allah, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥakam, from Ibrāhīm ibn ʿImrān al-Shaybānī, from Yūnus ibn Ibrāhīm, from Yaḥyā ibn Abī al-Ashʿath al-Kindī, from Muṣʿab ibn Yazīd al-Anṣārī, who said:
Amīr al-Muʾminīn ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib عليه السلام appointed me over four districts of al-Madāʾin—and he mentioned the hadith.

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: title of Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام, meaning Commander of the Faithful
key_terms.اسْتَعْمَلَنِي: appointed me to an office or administrative post
key_terms.رَسَاتِيقَ الْمَدَائِنِ: the rural districts or administrative regions of al-Madāʾin
key_terms.عَامِلِ أَمِيرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: the appointed administrator or governor under the Commander of the Faithful

ai.seo_question: What is the sanad for the narration of Muṣʿab ibn Yazīd al-Anṣārī in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage gives the transmission chain for reports narrated from Muṣʿab ibn Yazīd al-Anṣārī and identifies him as an official appointed by Amīr al-Muʾminīn ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib عليه السلام. The matn briefly states that he was appointed over four districts of al-Madāʾin, making the report relevant to historical transmission and governance under Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Everything in this book that is narrated from Musab ibn Yazid Al-Ansari, the governor appointed by Commander of the Faithful (as), has been transmitted by me from my father and from Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan - may Allah (swt) be pleased with them both - from Sad ibn Abdullah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ali ibn Al-Hakam, from Ibrahim ibn Imran Al-Shaybani, from Yunus ibn Ibrahim, from Yahya ibn Abi Al-Ashath Al-Kindi, from Musab ibn Yazid Al-Ansari, who said: "
Commander of the Faithful Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) appointed me over four districts of Al-Mada'in" - and he narrated the hadith in full.
